rules_line: Read and obey every .md file under $CHIPAGENTS_RULES_PATH (colon-separated) before doing anything else.

stages.title: Spec PDF to markdown
stages.task: Convert the spec PDF to markdown with the installed doc-convert skill. Keep tables, figures and section numbers. Write it to spec/<spec_stem>.md under the working directory.

stages.title: Formal methodology selection
stages.task: Run the skill Steps 1-5 and write the methodology report as DRAFT. Do not do Step 6 approval; the orchestrator asks the user.

stages.title: Jasper Connectivity App
stages.task: Run the full skill for the features routed to D-CONN in the approved methodology report.

stages.title: Jasper CSR App
stages.task: Run the full skill for the features routed to D-CSR in the approved methodology report.

stages.title: FPV (Path 1/2/3)
stages.task: Run the full skill for the features routed to D-FPV1/D-FPV2/D-FPV3 in the approved methodology report. Gate 4b and the pitfall guard are blocking.

stages.title: X-propagation
stages.task: Run the full skill for the features routed to D-XPROP in the approved methodology report.

stages.title: CEX debug / RCA
stages.task: Debug every failing property (CEX) produced by the earlier stages. Classify each against the spec and write the RCA outputs.

stages.title: Sign-off traceability
stages.task: Build the consolidated traceability across all app outputs of the earlier stages.

stages.title: Verification plan (vPlan)
stages.task: Create the vPlan from the spec, the methodology report and the traceability outputs.

stages.title: Parameter spec audit (always last)
stages.task: Run the parameter spec audit for this IP.
